title: acmella sodiroi
intro: Acmella sodiroi, commonly known as the Toothache Plant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. It is traditionally used for its analgesic and anti-inflammatory properties, providing relief from toothaches and other oral health issues. The health benefits of Acmella sodiroi include reducing pain and inflammation, as well as exhibiting antimicrobial and antioxidant activities. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as sesquiterpene lactones, particularly parthenolide, which are responsible for its analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects.
